reconstruction_loss_classification.description: Classification of information-loss mechanisms in mathematical reconstruction.

loss_classes.name: projection_loss_class
loss_classes.example: Pi_A mapping sub-threshold states to null.

loss_classes.name: multi_branch_loss_class
loss_classes.mechanism: Primitive branching dynamic with multi-valued continuation.

loss_classes.name: selection_induced_information_loss
loss_classes.mechanism: Discarding of valid but non-selected admissible paths.

loss_classes.name: epsilon_boundary_reconstruction_failure
loss_classes.mechanism: Singular behavior at exact parameter limits.

loss_classes.name: asymptotic_reconstruction_instability
loss_classes.mechanism: Divergent ambiguity over infinite iteration recursive systems.
